entries.speaker: Security Shadow
entries.en: They got past the security system!?

entries.speaker: Security Shadow
entries.en: ...You cannot go any further! You are[n]trespassing on Lord Madarame's[n]territory!
entries.uk: ...Далі ви не пройдете! Ви вдерлися[n]на територію лорда Мадараме!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You guys ain't got nothin' on us!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I'm more scared of screwin' up and[n]havin' Ann yell at me!
